steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Refracting telescopes use a convex objective lens to gather and focus light | Key Fact: Reflecting telescopes use a concave primary mirror; Newtonian and Cassegrain are common designs | Key Fact: Magnification = focal length of objective / focal length of eyepiece | Key Fact: Resolving power is the ability to distinguish fine detail; larger apertures give better resolution

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from telescopes &amp; instruments, and one past-paper question.
